reports.title: Pool 12, Mississippi River (Dubuque) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in backwater areas with woody structure, or in side channels where there is a little bit of flow.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use spinnerbaits or in-line spinners along vegetation lines in backwater areas, or along areas with rip-rap.
Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Throw inline spinners or crankbaits along rocky areas with some current/current breaks.

reports.title: Lake Delhi (Delaware) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Anglers are catching bass and some crappie.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Cast artificial lures or crankbaits along shoreline areas and around the docks.
White Crappie - Fair: Try fishing around shoreline structure near fallen trees in the 8-10 feet of water jigging colored tube jigs or hair jigs. A live minnow tipped under a slip bobber can be very effective.

reports.title: Black Hawk Lake (Sac) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Pick up crappie from shore. Use a piece of crawler on a jig or a small minnow along shore in Town Bay and near the inlet bridge area. Fish are up to 12-inches.

reports.title: Brushy Creek Lake (Webster) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappie near submerged structure in 5-15 feet of water.

reports.title: Swan Lake (Carroll) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Target black crappie from the fish house and by the jetties this time of year. Most fish are 9- to 10-inches. Use a small jig tipped with a piece of crawler or minnow fished under a bobber from shore and from the jetties.

reports.title: Spirit Lake (Dickinson) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Anglers are catching quality-sized fish..

reports.title: Big Hollow Lake (Des Moines) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies have returned to shallower water along the north side of the lake where they are feeding on the little fish drawn there by the zooplankton attracted by the sunshine warming the water just a little bit.

reports.title: Lake Belva Deer (Keokuk) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass are holding in 4-7 feet of water. Work the flooded trees with some plastics.

reports.title: Lake Darling (Washington) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies are moving back into shallow water around the rocks and the tree falls. Don't pass by the brush piles across from the main boat ramp.
Largemouth Bass - Good: The mid-sized bass are working the shallows looking for the little bluegills and along the rip-rap hunting for some late season crawdads.

reports.title: Lake Geode (Henry) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappies along the rip-rap in the sunshine and along the long mounds across from the beach.

reports.title: Lost Grove Lake (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Work the edges of the weed beds on the north side of the lake where the bass can enjoy that last little bit of warmth from the fall sun. Soft plastics in pumpkinseed colors are a favorite.

reports.title: Wilson Lake (Lee) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Find bass in brush piles and downed trees in the shallow water of the lake.

reports.title: Coralville Reservoir (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Slow: Crappie are suspended and scattered.
White Crappie - Slow: Use minnows in the brush piles.

reports.title: Iowa Lake (Iowa Co.) (Iowa) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Use soft plastics or minnows around the brush piles.
Largemouth Bass - Good: Use jerk baits, chatter baits or square bill crankbaits in 8-10 feet of water in the mornings. Anglers are catching some on topwater in the mornings or evenings.

reports.title: Lake Macbride (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Fair: Some days are better than others; use jigs tipped with plastics or minnows around brush piles or aquatic vegetation. Most fish are 9- to 12-inches with a few larger ones.

reports.title: Rathbun Reservoir (Appanoose) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Target crappies around brush piles and closer to shore as the water cools.

reports.title: Big Creek Lake (Polk) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Try trolling or jigging panfish plastics over roadbeds and brush piles in water less than 15 feet deep. Shore anglers can try the rock fishing jetties in the early mornings and evenings.

reports.text:

Largemouth Bass - Fair: Greenfield has a high percentage of 12- to 14-inch largemouth bass.

reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Troll the roadbeds or fish along deep tree piles to find black crappies. Sorting is needed for larger fish.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass anglers are finding fish in deep tree piles and along the roadbed.

reports.title: Pool 16, Mississippi River (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Places to try are Sunset Marina and the Andalusia Island complex..

reports.title: Pool 17, Mississippi River (Muscatine) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Status Unsure: Try vertical jigging with minnows or floating minnows under a bobber around brush piles in the backwaters and side channels. Expect the bite to pick up as water temperatures drop. Places to try are Big Timber or Cleveland Slough..

reports.title: Pool 09, Mississippi River (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Crappie bite is improving. Use light tackle in 4-6 feet of water in trees and stumps in slight current..
Largemouth Bass - Good: Largemouth fall feeding is underway. Cast plastics or buzz-baits along thick vegetation in upper portions of backwaters..
Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Smallmouth bass are prepping for winter and actively feeding along main channel. Use inline spinner-baits along rip-rap.
